selection: All 1113 historical commands, no outcome/feature exclusion. Historical development population, not fresh holdout.

adjudication.variation: E2E primary engine/seed and final quality/proof variations are observations, never hash-equivalence validity gates.
adjudication.censoring: Retain TIMEOUT/OOM/NOT_RUN and capture failures in denominators. All arms of a command have the same call limit. Ordinary calls get 100s execution; named long commands 180s.
adjudication.phases: Main e2e 3 repeats timing; long-repeat additional4 separately; trace off/timing/trace 2 blocks separately. No overhead subtraction or automatic winner.
adjudication.features: Exact F/u/d from captured ORIGINAL singleton rows; distinguish captured features from runtime partial/lazy features and actual budgets.
adjudication.scope: All arms use optimized refine maxPasses16. DIRECT retains common tiny/direct/hard guards and only skips quality probes. No isolated matrix calls in this campaign.
adjudication.analysis: Full E2E time/tail and actual quality losses; ALL/per-save and mirrorGroup dependence explicit. Later triage fitting must use group-disjoint validation, not repeated calls as independent inputs.
